title: Design System: Otto 在线编舞台

slate.purpose: The printed chrome, front to back: header, left column, right column and status bar. `#3B484C` lifts a row off it, and `#1E2A32` is the recessed window the robot stands in.

ivory.purpose: The page: the mat around the stage window, all primary text on slate, and the reversed selected row. The reference measures #F2EAD6 (L* 92.8); the shipped paper sits one step down at L* 89.3 (ΔE ~2.5) because a 710px panel at L* 93 glares on a real screen. The one recorded deviation from the measured palette.

bed.purpose: The binding only: 6px page edge on all four sides, the 20px imprint band, the primary button fill, the playhead chip. Never a working surface.

vermilion.purpose: States that move or destroy: the playing row's fill (#8F2A12), the ruler cursor, the current frame's rail tick, the danger hover, the warning line. Never a background for body text.

bottle.purpose: The confirmed connection, as the 8px dot. On slate it holds 5.6:1, so the status word beside it stays ivory and the dot carries the whole signal.

ui.purpose: Every label, value and heading, set in Archivo Narrow (embedded base64 woff2, latin subset, 400/700). Measured 10x'M' at 13px = 88.80px; the Arial fallback would be 108.30px.

ui-mobile.purpose: The same single size raised for a phone held at arm's length.

data.purpose: The sequence JSON. A different substance from a label, so it gets the mono stack at 11.5px.

data-inline.purpose: Angle pairs inside frame rows and the refdes chips beside each axis name.

shadows.name: contact-shadow
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the design, and it is cast by light, not drawn by CSS: the robot's real shadow on the cream page is what holds a white model on a light ground.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Two-tone, because one colour cannot survive two substances: an ivory ring alone disappears on the page, a slate halo alone disappears on slate.

motion.name: state-fill
motion.purpose: Button, preset and row hover/active fills.

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: The only element that moves on its own.

gradients.name: servo-scale
gradients.value: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(242,234,214,.42) 0 1px, transparent 1px 15px) over a 1px rule
gradients.purpose: A graduation scale for 0–180°, one tick every 15°, drawn in ivory on the slate chrome. Functional measurement, not decoration.

gradients.name: ruler-scale
gradients.value: repeating-linear-gradient major every 50px / minor every 10px at rgba(28,25,19,.42) and .20
gradients.purpose: The graduation under the stage, drawn in ink on the page rather than in ivory on a dark stage.

breakpoints.name: desk-narrow
breakpoints.note: Columns tighten; the rack narrows with the viewport.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.note: One stack, stage first via order:-1; the chrome runs full width and the hairlines become block edges.

breakpoints.name: captions
breakpoints.note: The stage's right-hand caption drops out and the two footer bands wrap instead of colliding.

breakpoints.name: handheld
breakpoints.note: Type 13→15px, 42px touch targets, frame actions wrap under their row.

components.name: Section Head
components.description: Uppercase tracked title in ivory with a right-aligned micro tag in secondary silk, separated by a single hairline. No background, no box.

components.name: Servo Row
components.description: Two lines, as in the printed original. Line one: name in 700, an outlined mono key chip, the range description inline in secondary silk, the value flush right. Line two: the ticked rule with a 3px ivory bar thumb. Axes run lh rh ll rl lf rf — hands first, then legs, then feet.

components.css: .servo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:20px minmax(0,1fr);gap:6px;padding:3px 0 1px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,234,214,.15)}.servo-idx{font-family:'Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace;color:#B4A98D}.servo-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px}.servo-name{font-weight:700;display:flex;gap:6px;color:#F2EAD6}.servo-desc{font-family:'Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace;color:#CFC4A8;border:1px solid rgba(242,234,214,.3);padding:0 3px;text-transform:uppercase}.servo-help{color:#B4A98D;flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.servo-val{margin-left:auto;font-weight:700;color:#F2EAD6}input[type=range]{-webkit-appearance:none;height:14px;margin:1px 0 0;background:transparent;width:100%}input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{height:14px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(242,234,214,.42) 0 1px,transparent 1px 15px) left center/100% 7px no-repeat,linear-gradient(rgba(242,234,214,.5),rgba(242,234,214,.5)) left center/100% 1px no-repeat}input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:3px;height:14px;border-radius:0;background:#F2EAD6}

components.name: Pose Cell
components.description: A printed table cell in a two-column grid, not a button: no border box, no fill, no radius. Name in 700 on one line, the number centred against the right edge, and the servo description carried by title and aria-label instead of printed — sixteen two-line descriptions were the densest wall in the interface.

components.name: Frame Table Head
components.description: The row that makes the rack a timetable instead of a stack: 帧 / 类型 / 参数 · v / d, one hairline thick, in secondary silk.

components.name: Frame Row
components.description: A table row on the slate block, lifted with slate-2. Mono index, type label (振荡 in goldenrod), one line of mono angle pairs with the timing after it and nothing else — at 380px row actions cost a third of the width. Active reverses the whole row to the page; previewing fills it with #8F2A12.
components.html: F1姿态ll90v=800ms · d=100ms
components.css: .frame{display:grid;grid-template-columns:30px 40px minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;position:relative;padding:5px 8px 5px 0;cursor:pointer;background:#3B484C;color:#F2EAD6;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,234,214,.13)}.f-id{font-family:'Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace;color:#B4A98D}.f-type{letter-spacing:.1em;color:#CFC4A8}.frame.osc .f-type{color:#C49031}.f-params{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 9px;font-family:'Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace}.f-params em{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;font-style:normal}.f-params b{color:#B4A98D;font-weight:400;margin-right:2px}.f-params i{color:#B4A98D;font-style:normal;white-space:nowrap}.frame.active{background:#F2EAD6;color:#1C1913}.frame.active .f-id,.frame.active .f-params b,.frame.active .f-params i{color:rgba(28,25,19,.78)}.frame.playing{background:#8F2A12}.f-acts{margin-left:auto;display:flex;white-space:nowrap}.f-acts button{padding:0 4px;border:0;border-left:1px solid rgba(242,234,214,.2);color:#CFC4A8;min-height:22px;line-height:20px}

components.name: Frame Toolbar
components.description: 当前帧 ↑ ↓ 编辑 删除 under the timing fields, acting on the selected frame and disabled when there is none. Row actions moved here when the rack narrowed to 380px; the timing labels stay at 耗时 / 延迟 because the row already says 当前帧.
components.html: 当前帧

components.name: Tick Rail
components.description: A 16px index column beside the frame table: one tick per frame, the current one wider and vermilion. Each tick is drawn by its own row so it cannot drift.

components.name: Ruler + Playhead
components.description: The last cell of the play row, as in the reference: 1 / 4 in mono ink, divided from 停止预览 by the same 1px rule as the buttons. No separate ruler strip.
components.css: .ruler{position:relative;height:26px;display:flex;align-items:center;padding-right:58px;border-top:1px solid rgba(28,25,19,.22);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(28,25,19,.22);background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(28,25,19,.42) 0 1px,transparent 1px 50px) left bottom/100% 9px no-repeat,repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(28,25,19,.2) 0 1px,transparent 1px 10px) left bottom/100% 4px no-repeat}.playhead{margin:5px 0 5px auto;padding:0 7px;font-family:'Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace;color:#1C1913;background:#C49031;line-height:16px}

components.name: Page Caption
components.description: Printed on the mat, not floating over the canvas: the stage's two top corners carry 预览 · 正面 and 真机标定 90° · 6 DOF · 正交投影; 正视 1:1 · 网格 60px · 舵机限位 0–180° sits under the window.
components.html: 预览 · 正面真机标定 90° · 6 DOF · 正交投影

components.name: Pane Foot + Imprint
components.description: Each pane closes with its own 22px status line behind a hairline — 中立 90° / 限位 0–180° under the poses, OTTO-SEQ v1 · 离线可编 / UTF-8 · N FRAMES under the code strip — and the whole page closes with the goldenrod imprint band: 1971 · POCKET TIMETABLE No.04.

components.name: Scrollbar
components.description: A drawn scrollbar, never the system's: 12px lane, 1px hairline on its inner edge, 4px square ivory thumb, no buttons or arrows. Hover brightens; dragging fills it with the binding gold. Chromium ignores ::-webkit-scrollbar* once scrollbar-width/scrollbar-color exist, so those properties are kept out of the file on purpose.

components.name: Hover Note
components.description: A single 22px `?` button at the end of the timeline head row opens one 276px ivory card (1px ink border, square corners, no shadow) hanging 7px below it, joined by an 8px connector line. The card holds both definitions as two rows divided by a hairline, with the variable names in mono vermilion so they match the tokens in the rows. Shown on hover and keyboard focus, and pinned open by click (Esc or an outside click dismisses) because a phone has no hover; never the browser's own tooltip.
components.html: 姿态帧一个定格的姿势 + 移动时长。…振荡帧绕一个中心姿态往返摆动。…

narrative.northStar: 两重黑的时刻表 — The Timetable in Two Darknesses
narrative.overview:
The tool is a 1971 pocket timetable printed in two darknesses. Slate #2B3A40 runs the chrome — header, both columns, status bar. A deeper #1E2A32 is the stage plate, sunk one tone so the centre reads as recessed rather than printed. A goldenrod binding holds the whole page.

There is no paper at page scale. Ivory #E9E0CA is ink: type on both dark tones, the reversed selected row, the primary action's fill, the modal, the tooltip. A white robot on cream measured 1.0x separation and looked weightless; on the window it measures 2.7x and reads as an object.

Both earlier attempts failed the same way — they guessed, then over-corrected. The palette came from pixel measurement, and the third dark tone came from measuring the complaint: the stage was 37% of the screen at L* 86 while the chrome sat at L* 29. Removing the paper took the page from L* 55.7 to 31.7.
keyCharacteristics: Two darknesses only: slate chrome, a deeper window for the stage
No paper surface at page scale — ivory is ink and reversal, never a panel
Goldenrod only as the binding: a 16px edge, 9px mullions, one imprint band
The frame rack is a table: a named header row, four fixed columns, hairline rows lifted in slate-2
Servo rows are two lines — name, key chip, range, value, then the ticked rule
White shell at L* 90 against a window at L* 16: a 2.7x separation
One real shadow: the robot's own, cast by the key light into the window

rules.name: Three Substances Rule
rules.body: Slate is the chrome, ivory is the page, gold is the binding. They never trade places: the stage is never dark, the chrome is never paper, and gold is never a working surface. Measured shares — 42 / 41 / 6 — are the check.

rules.name: Measured Palette Rule
rules.body: Every tone and every frame line must be sampled from the reference image, not chosen by eye. #2B3A40, #F2EAD6 and #C49031 came from pixel measurements, and so did the 16px edge, the 9px mullions and the 300/710/380 split; a 'better contrast' or 'easier' substitution is what turned the ground inside out twice.

rules.name: Keep the Window Empty Rule
rules.body: The window is the only calm surface in the interface. No cards, no docks, no paper, no floating chrome — only the model, its shadow and the faint floor grid.

rules.name: One Size Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one type size, 13px (15px below 600px). Hierarchy is spent on weight, case, tracking, reversal and rule.

rules.name: Printed Row Rule
rules.body: Rows are never cards: a 1px hairline, fixed columns, a header row that names them once, and no gap between rows. A row may be lifted with slate-2 or reversed to the page, never outlined.

rules.name: No Elevation Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats and nothing has a blur. Depth is printing order — binding, chrome, page, window — and selection is the page showing back through the chrome.

rules.name: No Side Stripe Rule
rules.body: State is a filled row, a reversed cell, or a drawn rule. An accent bar down one edge of a row or a toast is the generic pattern this world is trying to escape.

rules.name: Instrument Rule
rules.body: A drawn instrument must print real data. The playhead shows the true frame count at rest, the ruler cursor sits at activeFrame/(n-1), and each rail tick is drawn by its own row so it cannot drift.

rules.name: Glare Rule
rules.body: Measured colour is the starting point, not the endpoint: a tone that is right in a still can be wrong at full size. The page was pulled from L* 92.8 to 89.3 and the model's rig dimmed (key 2.35, hemi 1.85) because the centre panel behaved like a light box. Every such step is measured before and after and written down; a step without numbers is a guess.

dos: Keep the goldenrod binding visible on all four sides
Keep the slate chrome continuous from the header to the status bar
Sample every colour from the reference before using it
Print the row number in the margin (R1–R6, P01–P16) when a head promises a count
Draw a scale whenever a number has a range
Use the mono stack only for machine output, timings and inline axis tokens
Order the axes by how a pose is read — hands, legs, feet — not by pin order
Treat ivory as ink — never lay a cream panel at page scale
donts: Pick a palette by eye or by contrast preference
Make the stage a dark box
Turn the left margin into paper or the right margin into a card stack
Add a second type size for hierarchy
Round a corner, lift a row with a shadow, or blur anything
Let the frame table drift apart into floating cards
Use a gradient as surface decoration
Reintroduce an icon set — labels are the icons
Tint a whole axis to signal left or right
Give the stage a paper mat or the chrome a paper panel
